business: All Brunswick Van Lines / All Brunswick Moving & Storage
summary: All Brunswick Van Lines is a family-run, Wheaton World Wide Moving interstate agent in Dayton, NJ (founded 1986, incorporated as All Brunswick Moving & Storage Inc.) handling residential, corporate, international and storage moves across NJ and nationwide. It is small (4 power units / 2 tractors per FMCSA-derived fleet data; 21 jobs on its 2020 PPP filing) but carries unusually strong reputation signals: BBB A+ accredited with one complaint in three years, 4.8 on Angi across 57 reviews, and 56 Yelp reviews. Everything runs through a phone-and-in-home-survey quote funnel with no online booking, no careers page, and hiring ads that ask applicants to call the office.

facts.fact: Business started 10/28/1986 and incorporated 4/10/1986 in New Jersey; BBB lists 40 years in business and a second alternate name, 'Wheaton Van Lines'.
BBB-accredited since 6/27/2017 with an A+ rating, 1 complaint filed in the last 3 years, and 0 BBB customer reviews.
Ownership/management listed as Mr. Steve Morgen, President, and Mr. Patrick Juarez, Vice President; FMCSA-derived carrier data lists Patrick Juarez as company officer.
Owners Steve Morgen and Patrick Juarez started the company in 1986, became a Wheaton agent in 1988, and were named Wheaton's 2018 Agent of the Year.
Services listed as residential moves, corporate relocation, international moves, storage (heated, sanitized South Brunswick warehouse), and boxes/supplies.
Office at 182 J Ridge Road, Dayton, NJ 08810 with phone (732) 274-1881, toll-free (800) 443-4750, fax (732) 274-1682 and a single sales@ inbox for sales, service and technical contacts.
The company asks customers to fill out a web form so a salesperson can schedule a free, no-obligation in-home survey, and states a detailed inventory is produced before loading.
Interstate payment accepted by cash, money order, certified check or cashier's check, with credit card only after prior credit approval.
Angi profile shows 4.8 stars from 57 reviews, with customer comments crediting an in-home estimator (Linda) and crews of several men per move.
Yelp listing carries 56 reviews and 47 photos, including recent 2025 reviews praising a smooth estimate-to-move process and one 2025 one-star review disputing the final cost.
FMCSA carrier record USDOT 866526 / MC97183, active since March 2000, reports 4 trucks (all owned), 2 tractors, 3 trailers, 6 drivers and about 100,000 miles reported for 2025.
SBA PPP records show one loan of $168,750, forgiven, with 21 jobs reported in 2020; FMCSA MCS-150 census update dated Apr 15, 2026.

operations_signals: All quoting flows through a web form that triggers an office callback to book a free in-home survey; there is no online self-scheduling, instant price or booking calendar (https://allbrunswick.com/request-a-quote/).

Published hours are Mon-Fri 8:00-17:00 with Saturday and Sunday closed per third-party listings, with no published after-hours or emergency dispatch line (https://www.mapquest.com/us/new-jersey/all-brunswick-van-lines-1054888).
Contact surface is heavily phone/fax based: main line, toll-free line, fax number and shared sales@ inbox rather than department queues (https://allbrunswick.com/aboutus/).

Storage is operated from a separate heated, sanitized South Brunswick warehouse with shrink-wrapped upholstered furniture, i.e., inventory handled across two sites (https://allbrunswick.com/storage/).
Job ads explicitly assign the driver 'accurate completion of paperwork on assigned jobs' alongside taking inventory of every shipment (https://linkedin.com/company/all-brunswick-van-lines-inc).

Payment for interstate moves is paper-instrument heavy (cash, money order, certified check, cashier's check) unless credit is pre-approved, with no online payment path (https://allbrunswick.com/portfolio/planning-your-interstate-move).

Corporate relocation work is positioned around a single point of contact per move and coordination with HR/relocation managers, i.e., coordination-heavy account handling (https://allbrunswick.com/corporate-relocation/).
Marketing runs a newsletter capture offering a 30-day downsizing guide, aimed at senior/downsizing moves (https://themavinsgroup.com/partners-1/allbrunswickmoving).
hiring_signals: LinkedIn company page carries 2021 posts recruiting full-time drivers and helpers for local household moves: pack, load/unload, take inventory, handle customer requests, complete job paperwork; CDL a plus (https://linkedin.com/company/all-brunswick-van-lines-inc).

Recent Facebook hiring post (May 21) seeks full-time Drivers for local household moves and tells applicants to apply by calling (732) 274-1881, with tips adding $2-4/hour (https://www.facebook.com/allbrunswick/posts/all-brunswick-moving-storage-is-a-full-service-moving-company-looking-for-full-t/1486874326783502).

A Facebook video states the company is 'hiring drivers and helpers immediately' for Central New Jersey (https://www.facebook.com/allbrunswick/videos/we-are-hiring-drivers-and-helpers-immediatelylocation-central-new-jersey-competi/1089686394233500).

No careers page exists on the company site (/careers/ returns HTTP 404) and no current All Brunswick posting was found on Indeed, ZipRecruiter or SimplyHired; hiring runs through social posts and phone intake (https://allbrunswick.com/careers/).

LinkedIn lists only 4 employee profiles and 30 followers for a company of 11-50, consistent with a crew workforce that is not office-based on LinkedIn (https://linkedin.com/company/all-brunswick-van-lines-inc).
review_themes: Consistent praise for the in-home estimator and office staff by name, with customers noting the walk-through and guidance on what to pack themselves (https://www.angi.com/companylist/us/nj/dayton/all-brunswick-van-lines-inc-reviews-2091594.htm).

Crew conduct and care get the strongest positive comments: on-time arrival, extensive wrapping, furniture reassembly, and repeated use for second, third and fourth moves (https://www.yelp.com/biz/all-brunswick-van-lines-dayton-8).

Estimate accuracy is polarizing: several reviewers report final cost at or below estimate, while a 2025 one-star reviewer says the weight-based estimate was badly low and disputes manager conduct (https://www.yelp.com/biz/all-brunswick-van-lines-dayton-8).
An older moving-forum thread raised the same estimate-basis and valuation-coverage confusion for an interstate move (https://www.movingscam.com/forum/viewtopic.php?t=21080).

Complaint volume at BBB is very low (1 in three years) and there are no BBB customer reviews, so most public sentiment sits on Google/Yelp/Angi rather than BBB (https://www.bbb.org/us/nj/dayton/profile/moving-companies/all-brunswick-van-lines-0221-17002030/more-info).

Reviewers frequently name individual office and sales staff, which suggests reputation depends on a few people rather than a scripted process (https://www.mapquest.com/us/new-jersey/all-brunswick-van-lines-1054888).
tech_footprint: Website is WordPress with visible unfinished placeholder copy on the home page ('Some text should be hrre...'), an outdated copyright line in the footer and mixed 30/32/40-year claims (https://allbrunswick.com/).
Quote capture is a generic WordPress form (move date, size of move, origin/destination ZIP, contact fields) that promises a callback to schedule a survey (https://allbrunswick.com/request-a-quote/).

The Wheaton agent page runs a separate 'Ballpark Estimate 2023' widget with origin/destination ZIP, move date, size and services, i.e., lead capture split across two systems (https://www.wheatonworldwide.com/find-a-local-agent/agents/all-brunswick-van-lines-inc).
No online booking, customer portal, live chat, or online payment is visible; the only contact paths are phone, fax and shared email (https://allbrunswick.com/contact/).

Social footprint spans Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Flickr and LinkedIn, with Instagram used for award and crew shout-out posts rather than lead capture (https://www.instagram.com/allbrunswickmoving).
Crunchbase (third-party, modelled) estimates roughly 385 monthly web visits and about $92.1K annual IT spend (https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/all-brunswick-van-lines).

Google reviews are surfaced through an embedded widget on the testimonial and Wheaton agent pages rather than shown natively on the site (https://www.wheatonworldwide.com/find-a-local-agent/agents/all-brunswick-van-lines-inc).
growth_signals: Named Wheaton's June 2026 Agent of the Month, the company's twelfth such award, in the same year it marks 40 years in business (https://www.instagram.com/p/DaoNng-u4va).

Won Wheaton's 2018 Agent of the Year, with the van line citing quality and cooperation across its 350+ agent network (https://www.wheatonworldwide.com/why-wheaton/agent-news/all-brunswick-van-lines-awarded-wheaton-agent-of-the-year).
LinkedIn profile states it has won the Angie's List Super Service Award since 2012 (https://linkedin.com/company/all-brunswick-van-lines-inc).

Carrier census (MCS-150) was updated Apr 15, 2026 and 2025 mileage is reported at about 100,000, indicating the fleet stayed active through the last filing cycle (https://www.lanefinder.com/c/all_brunswick_van_lines/866526).
Operates a heated, sanitized South Brunswick storage warehouse in addition to the Dayton office, and markets long- and short-term storage (https://allbrunswick.com/storage/).

Has a published partnership with a senior-move/downsizing specialist (The Mavins Group) aimed at older adults, a demand segment tied to NJ downsizing volume (https://themavinsgroup.com/partners-1/allbrunswickmoving).

Keeps hiring crews on a rolling basis ('hiring drivers and helpers immediately'), consistent with seasonal summer move peaks (https://www.facebook.com/allbrunswick/videos/we-are-hiring-drivers-and-helpers-immediatelylocation-central-new-jersey-competi/1089686394233500).
decision_maker: Steve Morgen, President and co-owner (also named as owner in Wheaton's agent-award release; Patrick Juarez is co-owner/VP) — sources: https://www.bbb.org/us/nj/dayton/profile/moving-companies/all-brunswick-van-lines-0221-17002030 and https://www.wheatonworldwide.com/why-wheaton/agent-news/all-brunswick-van-lines-awarded-wheaton-agent-of-the-year

inferences.inference: Estimate accuracy is the single biggest AI opportunity: automated in-home survey capture (photo/video inventory, cubic-foot and weight estimation) would address the recurring 'final bill vs estimate' complaints.
inferences.reasoning: Multiple reviews praise or attack the estimate, the complaints describe weight-based final billing, and the owner himself sometimes performs surveys; the process is manual walkthrough plus notes.

inferences.inference: A 24/7 AI phone/chat intake agent would capture demand the current funnel likely loses.
inferences.reasoning: Listing hours are Mon-Fri 8-5 with weekends closed, all quoting requires an office callback, and the only published channels are phone, fax and a shared inbox.

inferences.inference: Dispatch and crew scheduling are likely the operational bottleneck during peak season.
inferences.reasoning: FMCSA-derived data shows only 4 power units and 6 drivers against 56+ Yelp and 57+ Angi reviews and recurring 'hiring immediately' posts, implying heavy per-crew job volume, multi-site storage coordination, and reliance on added labor.

inferences.inference: Hiring friction is real: applicants must phone the office, and there is no careers page or ATS.
inferences.reasoning: Site /careers/ returns 404, no active job-board listings were found, and Facebook ads direct candidates to call; a small firm competing for CDL and helper labor without an application pipeline likely loses candidates to faster-responding competitors.

inferences.inference: Digital demand capture is underbuilt relative to reputation strength, so a content/lead-nurture agent has headroom.
inferences.reasoning: Third-party traffic estimates are in the low hundreds of visits per month while review counts are high, the site still carries placeholder copy, and quote capture is split between a WordPress form and a Wheaton ballpark widget.

inferences.inference: Repeat and referral business (second/fourth moves, senior-move partners) is a natural target for automated follow-up and referral campaigns.
inferences.reasoning: Reviewers describe using the company repeatedly, and the firm invests in a downsizing newsletter lead magnet plus a senior-move partnership, but no CRM or marketing automation is visible.

data_gaps: The ~418 Google review figure from the mapper brief could not be verified directly: movercompass.com returned HTTP 429 and Google's review panel is not fetchable; only Yelp (56), Angi (57) and MapQuest/Wheaton review widgets were confirmed.

No current (2025-2026) All Brunswick job postings were found on Indeed, ZipRecruiter, SimplyHired or the company site; the most recent dated hiring content is a 2021 LinkedIn post and undated/mostly 2026 Facebook posts.

Revenue, current headcount and fleet size conflict across sources (Manta ~30 staff and $1.65M; Crunchbase 11-50; PPP 21 jobs; FMCSA 6 drivers / 4 trucks), so size should be treated as a range, not a number.
BBB shows a second location record at 401 Bordentown Hedding Rd, Bordentown NJ, which could not be corroborated elsewhere and may be a duplicate record rather than a real branch.
No published pricing, tariff, service-area map or after-hours policy was found; no news coverage (local press) of expansion or new facilities was located.
The site's testimonials page rendered without readable review text, so on-site testimonial content could not be sampled.
